summary: Each window now draws on its own nested Canvas (added at runtime with a GraphicRaycaster when the scene authored none) that is on exactly while the window's CanvasGroup alpha is above KitSightline.HiddenAlpha; synced in SetCanvasGroupVisible and a new virtual LateUpdate. This is the open item of MENU_REDESIGN_B 46.3 (hidden graphics are still batched). Why: the menu was one 6,937-graphic canvas rebuilt every frame (1.4 ms of a 9 ms frame in a built player) because a hidden window's content animated; after, about 3,200 graphics stay on the shared canvas. Probed in editor Play (Arcade, Arena, Toybox open, take clicks, close); not hand-tested window by window, list in the checklist. Voyage code not touched.
